posts.description: As the time wastes away, she sits there, just listening all of the colorful emotions on the wall. She wants to tell somebody, anybody about them but no one is around. posts.title: sometimes
posts.description: I wish there was a word that could replace the word "sometimes". I feel myself always using that filler word. It's almost like a safe space for me to insert said word when I run out of things to say. That got me thinking about why I try to fill the void with filler words. Is it truly about me not being able to speak or is it more about me having no vocabulary to fill. I think both might be true. S
